name: ListClean Local — Email List Cleaning, No Upload (Private)
description:
Is there an email list cleaner that doesn't charge me per address — and doesn't keep a copy of my subscriber list?
ListClean Local does the offline 90% of list hygiene on your own machine, then RE-VALIDATES the cleaned file and shows its work.
WHAT IT DOES
• Finds the email column in your CSV (or reads a plain .txt list)
• Normalizes whitespace/case, drops empty rows, removes duplicates (counted)
• Rejects invalid addresses WITH the reason — no @, bad dots, missing TLD
• Splits out known disposable/throwaway domains (mailinator & friends)
• Flags role accounts (info@, support@…) — kept, but you should know who they are
• Suggests likely domain typos (gmial.com → gmail.com?) — suggestions only; it never "corrects" an address into a different person
• Spots probable duplicates via +tags and Gmail dots — reported, never silently merged
THE HONEST PART
Whether a mailbox truly exists can't be known offline, and this tool won't sell you a fake "deliverability score". What it guarantees is a syntactically clean, de-duplicated, fully-audited list — verified by a re-check pass on the output file itself.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Seeded 12-row list: 7 clean out, 1 duplicate removed, 2 invalid rejected with reasons, 1 disposable split out, 1 role account + 1 typo suggestion reported. Re-check: PASS.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no per-email credits, no subscription, no copy of your list on anyone's server. One payment, run it on every list you ever clean.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed.
